name: menoteam-agent
description: Pair one opt-in Codex session with Menoteam without transferring a credential file.

interface.shortDescription: Pair this repository with Menoteam in one approval flow.
interface.longDescription: Installs the Menoteam Agent onboarding skill and outbound Connector. Credentials are generated locally, an admin approves a short device code, and one dedicated Codex task is resumed without giving the computer a Slack token.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me connect this Codex to the Menoteam Agent Gateway safely.
